evidence.title: GitHub - zarazhangrui/frontend-slides: Create beautiful slides on the web using a coding agent's frontend skills · GitHub

name: Frontend Slides
summary: Agent skill that builds animation-rich, zero-dependency HTML presentation decks from scratch or from PowerPoint files.
description: A coding-agent skill packaged as a Claude Code plugin, also usable by Codex, OpenCode and other agents. It makes single-file HTML presentations with inline CSS and JS — no npm, no build tools — from 12 curated style presets plus 34 optional bold design systems from beautiful-html-templates. It generates visual previews for the user to pick a direction, converts PowerPoint decks while keeping images and notes, and ships PDF export and Vercel deploy scripts.
contains: single-file HTML decks with inline CSS and JS, no build tools
12 curated style presets across dark, light and specialty themes
34 optional bold design systems from beautiful-html-templates
generates visual style previews instead of asking for preferences
converts PowerPoint files, extracting text, images and notes
PDF export and Vercel deploy scripts
fixed 16:9 1920x1080 stage scaled to the viewport
